title: Quentin and the Provision
premise: Cyrus Oyelaran, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, discovers a tide-revealed cave holding the Provision — a legendary cache left by a vanished expedition a century ago. When he takes a brass key from it, he inherits both its promise and its curse: rival salvagers, a navy cover-up, and the cave's own collapsing clock all close in. Fleeing inland with an orphaned cartographer's daughter named Quentin and a disgraced guide, Cyrus must cross the range ahead of the snows to reach the Provision's true vault before his rivals or the navy do. In the end Cyrus learns the Provision was never treasure but a found family's testament — and by choosing Quentin over the fortune, he claims the only inheritance that matters.
about_author: Wren Dunmore is the pen name of a former marine surveyor who spent six seasons mapping cold-water wrecks before turning to fiction. They write adventure novels about people the wilderness keeps honest.

chapters.title: The Wreck Nobody Names
chapters.summary: Cyrus dives a navy-sealed wreck off the northern coast, finding cargo manifests that shouldn't exist. His POV establishes his solitary life and debts to a salvage syndicate. Emotional beat: restless competence masking loneliness.

chapters.title: Low Tide, Open Door
chapters.summary: A record low tide exposes a sea cave beneath the cliffs. Cyrus explores alone at dusk and finds a sealed chamber marked with an expedition crest from 1897. His POV; wonder curdling into unease as the water begins returning.

chapters.title: The Brass Key
chapters.summary: Inside the chamber Cyrus takes a heavy brass key from a dead man's satchel, leaving everything else. The tide traps him briefly; he nearly drowns escaping. His POV; greed and guilt in equal measure.

chapters.title: Quentin
chapters.summary: In the harbor town, Cyrus meets Quentin, a sharp twelve-year-old living rough after her cartographer father vanished surveying the range. She recognizes the crest on his key. Alternating POV with Quentin; first spark of reluctant alliance.

chapters.title: Men in Navy Coats
chapters.summary: Navy officers visit Cyrus's dockside shack, asking pointed questions about the cave and confiscating his dive logs. He lies badly. His POV; the stakes shift from money to survival.

chapters.title: The Syndicate Calls
chapters.summary: Cyrus's creditors, led by the ruthless Vess Halloway, reveal they've been watching him and demand the key as payment. He refuses and burns his contract. His POV; point of no return.

chapters.title: Running the Harbor
chapters.summary: A night chase through the fishing town as Halloway's men and the navy both hunt Cyrus. Quentin smuggles him out on her father's old survey boat. Dual POV; fear becoming trust.

chapters.title: The Father's Map
chapters.summary: Quentin reveals her father's last letter: he found the Provision's trailhead and never came back. Her map shows a pass through the range open only before snowfall. Quentin's POV; grief sharpened into purpose.

chapters.title: Hiring a Disgraced Guide
chapters.summary: They recruit Odile Ferran, a mountain guide blacklisted after losing a client, who agrees for reasons she won't share. Odile's POV introduces her guilt and suspicion of Cyrus's key.

chapters.title: First Ascent
chapters.summary: The trio enters the foothills; Odile tests them with a brutal pace. Cyrus hides the key's origin; Quentin proves herself navigating by her father's methods. Odile's POV; grudging respect forming.

chapters.title: The Navy's Shadow
chapters.summary: They spot a navy helicopter sweeping the valleys and go dark, traveling by night. Cyrus confesses part of the truth about the cave. His POV; the weight of secrets on new trust.

chapters.title: Vess on the Trail
chapters.summary: Halloway's hired climbers appear behind them on the trail, moving fast. Odile sets a decoy route through scree. Odile's POV; the chase becomes personal when she recognizes one of Halloway's men.

chapters.title: Quentin's Shortcut
chapters.summary: Quentin insists on her father's marked shortcut through a limestone karst; it saves a day but nearly costs Cyrus in a sinkhole. Quentin's POV; proving her father's legacy is real.

chapters.title: The First Waystation
chapters.summary: They find an 1897 expedition waystation, stocked and eerily preserved, with a journal naming 'the Provision' as something carried, not gold. Cyrus's POV; the legend begins rewriting itself.

chapters.title: Odile's Confession
chapters.summary: Stormbound in the waystation, Odile admits the client she lost was Quentin's father — she turned back and he went on alone. Quentin overhears. Odile's POV; betrayal and the fracture of the group.

chapters.title: Cold Camp
chapters.summary: Quentin refuses to speak to Odile; Cyrus mediates badly, then honestly, sharing his own abandoned family. First snow dusts the peaks early. Cyrus's POV; the found family taking shape under pressure.

chapters.title: The Pass Decision
chapters.summary: Two routes: the safe long way (too slow for the snows) or the Red Stair, a near-vertical route her father marked. They choose the Stair. Group decision scene, rotating POV; commitment despite terror.

chapters.title: The Red Stair
chapters.summary: A harrowing climb up cut steps in red rock; a rope fails and Odile saves Quentin at cost to her hands. Quentin's POV; forgiveness beginning in adrenaline and gratitude.

chapters.title: What the Navy Wants
chapters.summary: A downed supply cache reveals the navy has been hunting the Provision for decades — it contains something they buried and want kept buried. Cyrus's POV; the enemy's motive clarified.

chapters.title: Ambush at the Col
chapters.summary: Halloway's climbers ambush them at a mountain col; Cyrus bargains with the key's location to save Quentin, lying brilliantly. His POV; he discovers what he'll sacrifice.

chapters.title: Splitting Up
chapters.summary: To shake pursuit, Odile splits the party: she draws the hunters east while Cyrus and Quentin take the high route. Odile's POV; redemption sought in risk.

chapters.title: Alone With Quentin
chapters.summary: Father-daughter-in-spirit interlude: Cyrus teaches Quentin to read weather and stars; she teaches him her father's mapping shorthand. Quentin's POV; tenderness between crises.

chapters.title: The Glacier Crossing
chapters.summary: A crevasse field crossing goes wrong; Cyrus falls into a crevasse and finds 1897 bones and a second keyhole-shaped artifact wedged in ice. His POV; awe and dread entwined.

chapters.title: The Second Key
chapters.summary: Cyrus retrieves the artifact; Quentin realizes the two keys are halves of one mechanism. The snow line rises behind them. Quentin's POV; the puzzle clicking together as the clock accelerates.

chapters.title: Odile's Signal
chapters.summary: They find Odile's prearranged signal — but it's the distress variant. Choosing to detour, they track her. Cyrus's POV; loyalty outweighing the deadline.

chapters.title: Rescue on the Moraine
chapters.summary: They pull Odile from Halloway's men, but Cyrus is wounded and one key is seized. Odile's POV; guilt repaid, debt transformed into fierce protectiveness.

chapters.title: The Storm Wall
chapters.summary: An early blizzard front slams the range. They shelter in a hollow tree-line cave as temperatures plummet, rationing fuel. Rotating POV; nature as the indifferent third enemy.

chapters.title: Hollow Rations
chapters.summary: Starving days in the cave; Quentin's fever spikes. Cyrus ventures out into the storm for the waystation supplies marked on her father's map. His POV; love made literal in exposure.

chapters.title: The Medicine Run
chapters.summary: Cyrus reaches the waystation through whiteout, finds aspirin and the expedition's final letter revealing the vault's location: the Hollow Summit. Nearly dies returning. His POV; the legend fully humanized.

chapters.title: Fever Night
chapters.summary: Quenton's fever breaks at dawn; the three speak plainly about what happens after — whether there is an 'after' together. Quentin's POV; the family named aloud for the first time.

chapters.title: Halloway's Offer
chapters.summary: Halloway, also storm-delayed, corners them with overwhelming force and offers to let Quentin live if Cyrus surrenders both keys and the route. He pretends to accept. His POV; the con within the climax.

chapters.title: Betrayal Executed
chapters.summary: At the handoff, Cyrus springs Odile's counter-trap, triggering a rockslide that scatters Halloway's team; the second key is recovered in the chaos. Odile's POV; triumph shadowed by injury.

chapters.title: The Hollow Summit
chapters.summary: They summit the peak as the storm clears and find the vault door — two keyholes, one mechanism. Inside: not gold but the 1897 expedition's true cargo. Cyrus's POV; breathless revelation.

chapters.title: What the Provision Was
chapters.summary: The Provision is a testament: records, seeds, medicines, and letters from the expedition's survivors — a community's inheritance meant to be carried onward, not hoarded. Quentin's POV; understanding her father died carrying it forward.

chapters.title: The Navy Arrives
chapters.summary: A navy detachment reaches the summit demanding the cache be reburied as classified. Cyrus negotiates: the testament goes public, the navy's buried secret stays theirs. His POV; moral victory over force.

chapters.title: Halloway's Last Climb
chapters.summary: Half-mad from the mountain, Halloway attempts to seize the vault alone and is lost to a cornice collapse. Odile's POV; pity without absolution.

chapters.title: Descent
chapters.summary: The three descend together through deepening snow, carrying copies of the testament, leaving the original sealed as its keepers intended. Rotating POV; exhaustion transfigured into peace.

chapters.title: The Town That Forgot
chapters.summary: Back in the harbor town, they publish the testament; the navy quietly drops its interest; Cyrus's debts dissolve in the ensuing notoriety. Quentin's POV; the world rearranging around their choice.

chapters.title: Naming the Family
chapters.summary: Cyrus formally becomes Quentin's guardian; Odile takes rooms above the harbor chandlery and starts guiding again. Small domestic scenes carry enormous weight. Cyrus's POV; the inheritance claimed.

chapters.title: Next Tide
chapters.summary: Epilogue: months later, Quentin spots a new crest on a chart — another expedition, another trail. The three begin packing. Final image: the wilderness forgets nothing, and neither do they. Shared POV; the adventure continues.
